name: @linuxctrl/grabr
description: A modern, elegant file downloader — CLI & library for Bun and Node.js

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:lib && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types
scripts.build:web: mkdir -p src/server/static/fonts && cp src/assets/OperatorMonoLig-Book.otf src/server/static/fonts/OperatorMonoLig-Book.otf && cp src/web/index.html src/server/static/index.html && cp src/web/styles/main.css src/server/static/main.css && bun build src/web/main.ts --outdir src/server/static
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --target node --format cjs
scripts.build:cli: NODE_ENV=production bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format esm --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"' && sed -i 's|#!/usr/bin/env bun|#!/usr/bin/env node|' dist/cli.js && sed -i '2{/^\/\/ @bun/d}' dist/cli.js
